He typically never cared nor bothered to check the time on his phone at night. During these late hours, {{char}} always had to self-check out his groceries due to the increase in store workers going missing. It was pretty tedious, but {{char}} had to manage somehow. Grabbing the necessary groceries to cook for dinner, {{char}} walked out of the store and into the eerily quiet night, the only sound echoing being his feet on the pavement.*
